## About

Syed Mohamad Arif is a full-stack developer based in Sentul, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with 5+ years of product experience. He builds earned-wage access fintech at Paywatch across 6 markets (MY, HK, PH, ID, SG, VN), shipping React Native apps, Next.js portals, and Node / Fastify services, including payments and bank payout integrations. He works AI-first with Claude Code skills, MCP integrations, and automation pipelines. He is currently a Software Engineer (Mobile & Backend) at Paywatch Malaysia.

He offers freelance website and mobile app development services to Malaysian SMEs, startups, and international clients. Engagements run remotely across Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Shah Alam, Selangor, Penang, Johor) and worldwide. Invoicing is supported in MYR and USD.

Island-themed investment learning simulation for KENMS, IIUM. Students join with a module code and sail through 11 ports, each a lesson, with a scoreboard.

- Live: https://islesim.com

A daily storytelling Android application showcasing end-to-end mobile work, from UI/UX design to a production Play Store release. Demonstrates expertise in delivering production-ready, user-friendly applications.

## Services Offered

Syed Mohamad Arif provides freelance website and mobile app development services to clients in Malaysia and remotely worldwide.

### Website Development
Marketing sites, dashboards, and full-stack web applications. Built with React, React Router, and Next.js — typed, tested, and tuned for SEO and Core Web Vitals. Deliverables include:
- Responsive UI in React + Tailwind CSS
- Authentication, payments, and dashboards
- SEO, sitemap, and analytics setup
- Domain, hosting, and email setup
- Stack used: React, React Router, Next.js, Tailwind, Supabase, Vercel

### Mobile App Development
Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from one React Native + Expo codebase, with full release pipelines through EAS or Codemagic. Deliverables include:
- iOS and Android from one codebase
- Push notifications and deep links
- Over-the-air updates and crash reporting
- App Store and Play Store submission
- Stack used: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Firebase, EAS, Codemagic

### Process
1. Design — wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma
2. Development — typed, modular, version-controlled code with Git-based reviews and preview deployments
3. Production & Deployment — custom domain, SSL, analytics, and store submissions; monitoring and OTA updates after launch

Release pipelines run through Codemagic or Expo EAS, including Apple App Store and Google Play Store submission. Services cover design in Figma, development in TypeScript, testing, and deployment.

### Do you build both iOS and Android apps?
Yes. Syed Mohamad Arif builds cross-platform iOS and Android apps from a single React Native + Expo codebase, with native modules where needed. Full release pipelines run through Expo EAS or Codemagic, including Apple App Store and Google Play Store submission.

### Do you work on fintech and backend projects?

### What stack do you use?
React Native for mobile, Next.js and React 19 for web, and TypeScript with Node.js, Fastify, NestJS, and GraphQL for backend services. Data layers use PostgreSQL (Drizzle), Cosmos DB, or Firebase; delivery uses Codemagic, EAS, GitHub Actions, and Kubernetes. He also works AI-first with Claude Code skills and MCP integrations.

### How much does a mobile app cost in Malaysia?
Cost depends on scope, integrations, and timeline. A basic single-platform MVP typically starts in the low five figures MYR; a full cross-platform iOS and Android app with auth, payments, push notifications, and store submission usually lands in the mid-to-high five figures MYR. Syed Mohamad Arif provides clear, fixed-scope quotes after a free discovery call. Reach out at syedarifjr@gmail.com for a tailored estimate.
